attr.title: Need for Speed: Most Wanted
porter: TrimUI Smart Pro S / SpruceOS compatibility project contributors
attr.desc: ARMv7 compatibility port tested on TrimUI Smart Pro S with SpruceOS. Original game files are not included.
attr.inst: Install the package with PortMaster, place the supported 1.3.128 APK and main.1003128.com.ea.games.nfs13_row.obb in ports/nfsmw/gamedata, then launch from the SpruceOS menu.
